result.stdout:
Usage: klint-rs [<command>] [options]

  Shadow Rust architecture engine

Commands:
  stats          Print runs, violations reported and errors prevented, in total and per rule
  install-skill  Install the embedded klint-rules skill into agent config directories

Options:
  --config <dir>  Directory containing klint.yaml or klint.config.json (default: cwd)
  --json          Emit structured JSON to stdout
  --fix           Apply autofixes, then report what is left
  --hook          Count this run as an agent hook run in klint stats
  -V, --version   Print the installed klint-rs version
  -h, --help      Show this help

With no command, lints the project.
Run 'klint-rs <command> --help' for its options.

result.stdout:
Usage: klint-rs install-skill [options]

  Install the embedded klint-rules skill into agent config directories

Options:
  --agents <list>  Comma-separated: claude, codex, copilot, cursor, opencode (default: all)
  --symlink        Keep one skill in .agents/skills and symlink the others to it (default)
  --copy           Give every agent directory its own copy
  --force          Replace a skill directory klint did not install
  -h, --help       Show this help

Asks which agents and how to store the skill when run on a terminal without
--agents, --symlink or --copy.
